description: This file implements a Calendar service for Basecamp 3, including methods for creating, updating, deleting events, and handling authentication and user timezone retrieval.

classes.name: BasecampCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing the Calendar interface for Basecamp 3, managing event creation, updates, deletion, and authentication.

methods.name: hasFileExtension
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a file extension.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a URL.

methods.name: getBasecampDescription
methods.description: Generates an HTML description string for a calendar event, including title, date, time, attendees, and video call info.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Basecamp schedule via API.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing Basecamp event via API.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes (trashes) a Basecamp event via API.

methods.name: getUserTimezoneFromDB
methods.description: Retrieves user's timezone from the database.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Extracts user ID from an array of calendars.

methods.name: isValidFormat
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a supported calendar file extension.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Returns an empty array for event busy dates (stub).

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Returns an empty list of calendars (stub).
